dedup_rule: (1) rows of the same source_group with identical numeric vectors (>=6 non-null values) collapse to the lowest fuel_id; (2) 'X_<digit>' labels whose base label X exists in the same source_group collapse onto X; remaining members are merged by per-column median.
rule: group unit = source_group x test_year ('cell'); cells sorted by sha256(seed|cell); the first ceil(0.2 * n_cells) cells are LOCKED; no re-rolling

time_split.rule: dev fuels with known test_year; test = latest years until >=25% of them; train = earlier years; fuels without test_year excluded
